messages:
toni: Creating RC rc-2026.03.22-x (sha: b11e7d). Target promo window 21:00-21:30 UTC. Need quick signoffs: keystore rotation, KV warm on prod-shadow, smoke tests, and release notes. Will pin before promote. @ryan please run KV warm, @maya please sanity-check notes.

ryan: KV warm on prod-shadow finished: warmed 28 shards, hit_rate=0.90, mem=68%. One transient 502 retried automatically.

maya: Release notes updated; called out logits-normalization tweak and client migration tip. QA smoke checklist ready. +1.

qa-bot: Automated smoke: token_checks 198/200, error_delta +0.03% (ok), latency p95 +5% (ok). Two formatting edge cases flagged for manual review.

toni: Keystore rotated to kms-prod-12, decryption probe passed. Pinning now.

deploy-bot: /pin rc-2026.03.22-x -> pin_id=pin-13001, artifact=b11e7d, pinned_by=toni at 3960001245

toni: Starting canary: /promote rc-2026.03.22-x --to canary --percent 10 --duration 15m --pin

deploy-bot: Canary job started job-13002.

ops-oncall: Watching canary. Thresholds: errors +0.5% abs; latency p95 +25%.

(15m later)

ops-oncall: Canary OK: error_delta +0.01%, token_checks 199/200. Recommend staged prod promote: 25 -> 60 -> 100 with 5m guard after stage2.

toni: Initiating staged promote: /promote rc-2026.03.22-x --to prod --staged --stages 25,60,100 --pin

deploy-bot: Stage 1 -> 25% applied.

deploy-bot: Stage 2 -> 60% applied. Holding before final stage for 6m per ops due to upstream 429s last week.

(6m)

ops-oncall: Upstream backoff tweak applied, telemetry clear. Proceeding to final stage.

deploy-bot: Stage 3 -> 100% applied. Promotion complete. rc-2026.03.22-x live in prod. :tada:

toni: Post-promote checks active for 30m. Rollback quick commands in release doc: `/promote rc-2026.02.19-stable --to prod --pin --force`, `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/llm-service --to-revision=2250`, feature-gate off curl snippet.

maya: I'll add final canary summary to release notes and close thread after post window.
